headline: Nigerian Naira Gains Against Dollar as External Reserves Climb to $55.26bn
summary: The Nigerian naira strengthened marginally against the dollar at the official foreign exchange market as external reserves climbed to $55.26 billion.
why: Foreign exchange reserve accumulation provides central banks with greater capacity to defend currency stability and manage foreign exchange liquidity.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Higher foreign reserves support the local currency's value in the official market.
